tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Returns the 50 most common tags in the Glyfiq library with counts, plus the total icon count. Results are sorted by frequency (descending). Use it to pick effective search terms before calling search_icons. Takes no parameters. Rare tags are not listed; use search_icons for those.

tools.name: get_free_icons_sample
tools.description: Returns a random selection of free Glyfiq icons (name and tags) so you can see what the library covers. findings.detail: Description of "get_icon_svg" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.detail: Description of "list_tags" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
